data.title: Binghatti Grove
data.about:
Binghatti Grove at JVC offers luxury apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle, developed by Binghatti Developers. This off-plan property features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed with biophilic architecture, blending nature and contemporary living. The 42-story tower showcases elegant facades and sustainable materials. On the ground floor of Binghatti Grove, there are 16 retail spaces.

Residents can enjoy many amenities, including a serene pool deck, outdoor yoga areas, fitness zones, and sports courts. Binghatti Grove's location provides easy access to crucial routes like Al Khail Road, making it a prime spot for city living. Binghatti Grove in JVC combines luxury with sustainability, offering a unique living experience in Dubai’s thriving community.

characteristics_module.title: Retreat to Where Tranquility and Modernity Converge
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxury Apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle: These offer 1, 2, and 3 bedroom units designed with biophilic architecture, blending nature with modern luxury.
    Sustainable Living: Every element of Grove is crafted with sustainability in mind, from natural materials to energy-efficient design, ensuring a future-conscious lifestyle.
  • Modern Elegance: Grove showcases sleek, modern finishes with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and refined interiors designed for luxurious living.
  • Serene Sanctuary: Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, Grove offers a peaceful retreat from city life, surrounded by landscaped greenery and tranquil outdoor areas.
  • Luxury Amenities: The project features a variety of lifestyle amenities, including adult and children’s pools, a yoga area, fitness zones, and recreational spaces like a paddle court and basketball court.

location_tile.title: Luxury Living in Jumeirah Village Circle with Seamless Connectivity
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Grove at JVC offers luxury apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle, a family-friendly community. The prime location provides seamless access to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. Residents enjoy easy connectivity to key destinations like Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina. Binghatti Grove’s amenities enhance the appeal, with nearby parks, schools, and healthcare facilities. This off-plan property by Binghatti Developers combines luxury with convenience, making it perfect for families and professionals. The Binghatti Grove payment plan also offers flexibility, which is ideal for those seeking homes in JVC Dubai.

  • 5 Minutes to Circle Mall
  • 19 Minutes to Business Bay
  • 19 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
  • 21 Minutes to Burj Al Arab
  • 21 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 22 Minutes to Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa
